name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
steps: Plant your palms under your shoulders and rest your shins on the ball with your legs together.
Brace your abs firmly to hold a straight line from your head to your ankles.
Contract your abs and hip flexors to pull both knees smoothly forward toward your chest, rolling the stability ball underneath you.
Pause briefly with your knees tucked, then slowly extend your legs back out to the straight plank position.
tips: Keep your shoulders stacked steadily over your wrists without drifting backward as your legs extend.
Prevent your lower back from sagging when rolling the ball back to the starting position.
